examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, bhaggava, samayaṃ thūlūsu viharāmi uttarakā nāma thūlūnaṃ nigamo.

31590.meaning1: as trustworthy; as reliable; as stable

examples.text: atthi me attā'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati, n'atthi me attā'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati

attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?
na harāmi na bhañjāmi, ārā siṅghāmi vārijaṃ, atha kena nu vaṇṇena, gandhattheno'ti vuccati.
coro'si bālo'si mūḷho'si theno'sī'ti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno ayam'pi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

31592.commentary: (SNa) kumbhatthenakehī'ti ye paragharaṃ pavisitvā dīp'ālokena oloketvā parabhaṇḍaṃ haritu'kāmā ghaṭe dīpaṃ katvā pavisanti, te kumbhatthenakā nāma, tehi kumbhatthenakehi.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
